title: EscrowAgent
summary: Lock SPL tokens in a client/provider escrow, let the provider submit proof, and have the client confirm so the provider is paid.
what: EscrowAgent is an Anchor 0.32.1 escrow rail. initialize_protocol writes a singleton protocol_config PDA. create_escrow (seeds ["escrow", client, provider, task_hash]) funds a vault token account. The provider accepts, submits proof, and for MultiSigConfirm the client calls confirm_completion, which pays the provider, collects the protocol fee, and closes the escrow.
app_note: The page at /dapps/escrowagent/ is the generic IDL-driven wallet console. The lab tree is branch sol-college-devnet of Blockchains/escrowagent. The lab only changed declare_id to a unique lab program.

try_steps.do: Open /dapps/escrowagent/, switch to Devnet, and connect a wallet. The lab already ran the MultiSigConfirm happy path for 1_000_000 lab tokens with a 0 bps fee.
try_steps.see: Program DZJpVeE9…. Escrow 4EK362s6… should be closed; provider H2vegMao… received 1_000_000.

diagram: admin --initialize_protocol--> config; client --create_escrow--> escrow+vault; provider --accept/submit_proof--> ProofSubmitted; client --confirm_completion--> provider ATA, escrow closed.
accounts: escrow PDA seeds ["escrow", client, provider, task_hash]
vault seeds ["vault", escrow], authority seeds ["vault_authority", escrow]
innovation: Funds never auto-release at proof submission. Release is always a later confirm_completion (client) or provider_release (after the grace period).
exercises: Derive the escrow PDA from client, provider and task_hash.
Explain why OracleCallback is rejected at create_escrow.
not_covered: Disputes, expiry, provider_release, and non-zero protocol fees
objectives: Create or fund an EscrowAgent vault and name its authorities.
Complete one release or refund path on Devnet.
Explain who can move funds at each state.
prereqs: A Devnet wallet with practice funds.
student_outcome: Deposit into EscrowAgent and follow release or refund to the correct party.
